args.sql:
CREATE VIEW view_premium_quality_scans AS
SELECT 
    s.questregistry AS scan_id,
    p.vesseltag AS project,
    st.zonelabel AS site,
    s.chronotag AS timestamp,
    spc.scanresolmm AS resolution,
    spc.pointdense AS density,
    spc.coverpct AS coverage,
    spc.lappct AS overlap,
    spc.noisedb AS noise_level
FROM 
    scans s
JOIN 
    projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
JOIN 
    sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
JOIN 
    scanpointcloud spc ON s.questregistry = spc.arcref
WHERE 
    spc.noisedb < 1.5;
